## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: safe vehicle operation part one (lanes, passing, turning, speed, weather, night, impaired, distracted and aggressive driving, rural roads and interstates)
Knowledge facts: part C holds 34 fact blocks (sec07-F01 onward) from physical pages 42 to 51; part C2 holds 34 confusable and continuation blocks (sec07-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the back-cover publication line, the two-component structure and the 80 percent per-component passing standard from physical pages 1, 10, 68 and 84; the question count and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- IN-SAFEONE-A-COUNT — knowledge-exam question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-SAFEONE-A-TIME — knowledge-exam time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-SAFEONE-D-STATS — drowsy-driving statistics printed without a cited study (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- IN-SAFEONE-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- IN-SAFEONE-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: posted limits override the statutory defaults and school zone hours are local; the facts in this section carry no fees or service details.

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.
